SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No.
C. & S. Station,
No. S. B. D. 2120.
Date February 22, 1931
at 9 - 31.
Subject (in full) Attempt suicide at the Astor House Hotel room No247. committed by
Mrs. Hora ( Tatiana Loskaleva ) at about 4.45 p.m. 22/2/31.
Made by D.P.S. Medvedeff Forwarded by
Sapei Road
Station
At 6.15 p.m. 22/2/31 a telephone message was received from Dr.
Renner, that an attempt to commit a suicide was made by a foreign
lady residing at the Astor House Hotel room No247.
Inquiries were made by the undersigned and elicited the following:
the room No247 since October 6, 1930 has been occupied by Mrs. Hora, who some
time ago resided in this Hotel together with Mr. K.J. Hora, Czechoslo-
vakian, engineer, employed by Skodaworks. During about 8 years Mr. &
Mrs. Hora were known to the others as wife & husband, but few months
ago they separated on account that Mr. Hora fell in love with another
woman, daughter of Mrs. Gindiroff. Several attempts were made by Mrs.
Hora to return her husband, but without any success. Between 1 - 2
p.m. on 22/2/31 Mrs. R.M. Nevel, who is a good friend of Mrs. Hora,
visited the latter in her room and found her very nervous. At 4.45
p.m. at the same day Mrs. Nevel again visited Mrs. Hora and found her
lying in the bed. As Mrs. Hora, being called by Mrs. Nevel, did not answer
the latter informed the management of the Astor House Hotel and Dr.
Renner was called. He removed Mrs. Hora to the General Hospital and
his opinion is that Mrs. Hora poisoned herself by Veronal. As Dr.
Renner says the condition of Mrs. Hora is not serious and he expects
that after few days her health will be recovered. An empty tube su-

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
档案号
中央捕房，
编号 S. B. D. 2120。
日期 1931年2月22日
于 9 - 31。
事由（全称） 1931年2月22日下午约4时45分，霍拉夫人（塔蒂亚娜·洛斯卡列娃）在礼查饭店247房间企图自杀。
制作人 D.P.S. 梅德韦杰夫 转呈人
北四川路
捕房
1931年2月22日下午6时15分，接到雷纳医生的电话留言，称一名居住在礼查饭店247房间的外国女士企图自杀。
经具名人调查，获悉以下情况：自1930年10月6日以来，247房间一直由霍拉夫人居住，她此前曾与K.J.霍拉先生一同居住在该饭店。霍拉先生系捷克斯洛伐克籍工程师，受雇于斯柯达工厂。霍拉夫妇在近8年间被他人视为夫妻，但数月前两人分居，原因是霍拉先生爱上了金迪罗夫夫人的女儿。霍拉夫人曾多次试图挽回丈夫，但均未成功。1931年2月22日下午1时至2时之间，霍拉夫人的好友R.M.内维尔女士前往其房间探望，发现她神情非常紧张。同日下午4时45分，内维尔女士再次探望霍拉夫人，发现她躺在床上。由于霍拉夫人在内维尔女士呼唤下没有回应，后者遂通知礼查饭店管理层，并召请雷纳医生。雷纳医生将霍拉夫人送往广慈医院，他认为霍拉夫人服用了佛罗那（Veronal）毒药。据雷纳医生称，霍拉夫人的状况并不严重，预计数日后即可康复。一支据信
